title: Get Those FPS
description: Minecraft shouldn't feel like a slideshow. GET THOSE FPS is a lightweight optimization pack designed to get rid of the lag, boost frame rates, and provide the smoothest gameplay possible even on potato PCs.
body:
Minecraft shouldn't feel like a slideshow. GET THOSE FPS is a lightweight optimization pack designed to get rid of the lag, boost frame rates, and provide the smoothest gameplay possible even on potato PCs.

    
<details>
<summary>🚀 Extreme Performance</summary>

    Sodium & Sodium Extra: Advanced rendering engine and expanded video settings.

    Lithium: Optimized game logic and physics.

    C2ME: Multithreaded chunk loading and generation.

    FerriteCore: Significant RAM usage reduction.

    Entity Culling: Performance boost by hiding non-visible entities.

    BadOptimizations: Smooths out UI and micro-stutters.

    Krypton: Optimized network stack for lower ping.

</details>


<details>
<summary>⚔️ Competitive & PvP QoL</summary>

    Low Fire & Low Shield: Reduced visual clutter for maximum visibility.

    Shield Status & Fixes: HUD durability display and corrected shield positioning.

    Crosshair Addons: Fully customizable crosshair.

    Zoomify: Fast and smooth cinematic zoom.

    Consumable Optimizer: Optimized eating/drinking mechanics.

</details>



<details>
<summary>✨ Enhanched Visuals</summary>

    Iris Shaders: Native shader support.

    Continuity: Connected textures for glass and blocks.

    LambDynamicLights: Real-time lighting from held items.

</details>


<details>
<summary>🛠️ Utilities</summary>

    Ukus Armor HUD: Clean durability display for gear.

    AppleSkin: Hunger and saturation HUD indicators.

    ShulkerBoxTooltip: Hover preview for container contents.

    Chat Heads & No Chat Reports: Player avatars in chat and secure messaging.

</details>

<details>
<summary>📋 Technical Recommendations</summary>

    Allocated RAM: 6 GB is recommended for optimal stability and performance.

    Ready to Play: Pre-configured for immediate use; no setup required.

</details>
